finding: RapidOCR inference dominates warm OCR (~1.5 s of ~1.7 s); a cold worker adds ~1.0 s rapidocr import and ~0.8 s lazy model load. Reread adds 0.1-0.4 s; reconciliation, fidelity and parsing are each under 0.1 s.

observed.policy: single OrderedDict: normal OCR inserts trim to 16 entries, reread inserts trim to 64; reread entries therefore count against the 16 OCR slots
single OrderedDict: normal OCR inserts trim to 16 entries, reread inserts trim to 64; reread entries therefore count against the 16 OCR slots

cache_policy.finding: Normal OCR and reread results share one 16/64-trimmed OrderedDict, so rereads consume OCR slots: after 8 images the first image's OCR is still cached but its reread is not; after 20 images neither is.

optimisations_considered.pre-warm the OCR worker at startup: would remove ~1.8-2.3 s from the first upload at the cost of ~400-600 MiB idle RSS: an Owner trade-off, not implemented
optimisations_considered.separate reread cache budget: small latency gain on repeats; not implemented without a before/after on a repeat-heavy workload
optimisations_considered.drop an engine or the reread: rejected: both feed cross-family verification of critical facts
